data.name: Munabbar
data.gender_notes: Munabbar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Munabbar is an Arabic name that means 'raised to a high status' or 'exalted'. It symbolizes a person of great dignity and respect. The name Munabbar carries the meaning “Raised to a high status” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Munabbar usually hope their child will grow to embody raised to a high status and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Munabbar is associated with the concept of spiritual elevation and closeness to Allah.
